title: Add mouse support for player controls
description: Add mouse click support for player bar controls: seek by clicking on progress bar, toggle shuffle/repeat by clicking icons, volume control, etc.

title: Set custom theme
description: Allow users to set a custom theme for the application.

title: Make keybind help modal keybind configurable
description: The keybind that opens the keybind help modal should itself be configurable in the keybindings config.

title: Configurable navigation keybinds
description: Allow users to configure navigation keybinds instead of using hardcoded defaults.

title: Check album thumbnail download bug

description: There's a bug when exiting/closing the keybind help modal.

title: Add --daemon mode for background listening
description: Add a daemon mode that allows the application to run in the background and listen for connections/events without blocking the terminal.
